description: Measured locked-rotor peak torque of the 2005 Accord motor: S1 Table 3.2, p.16 (PDF 22). DC current applied with the rotor locked every 5 electrical degrees over a full cycle; torque from an in-line shaft sensor; the peak over position at each current. S1 does not restate the current pattern; ORNL's Prius reports use (Ia, -Ia/2, -Ia/2) (assumption A5 in README.md). S1 notes saturation becomes significant above about 175 A. Torque vs position (Fig. 3.7) is plotted only.
